title: Freelance Transcriptionist — Oromo
description: About Perle Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. You will be asked to complete a short qualification task — a 5-minute audio transcription sample in Oromo. Applicants who pass the qualification test will be onboarded immediately and assigned to production tasks. Perle is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
